ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth prompt injection hardening and evaluation framework tailored for real-time prompt engineering tests.
ideas.title: PromptGuard Red-Team Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages prompt-injection hardening and defensive layers similar to the BitGN Personal Agent Challenge winner, making it directly aligned with rigorous evaluation in a prompt engineering competition.

ideas.pitch: An automated evaluation harness that benchmarks different prompt architectures and models against specific reasoning and edge-case prompts.
ideas.title: PromptBench Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of benchmarking architectures and prompts as seen in the Cubist Systematic Strategies winning project, demonstrating deep technical rigor rather than just static text prompts.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent system that audits generative outputs and prompt responses for systemic algorithmic bias and constraint adherence.
ideas.title: MultiAgent Bias & Policy Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the Google Code Cure Hackathon winner by using multi-agent oversight to evaluate AI outputs, which appeals to judges looking for robust safety and reliability checks.

ideas.pitch: A developer-focused knowledge management pipeline that captures successful prompt templates, iterations, and failure modes during live experimentation.
ideas.title: DevFlow Prompt Knowledge Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets knowledge management workflows that developers and judges instantly appreciate, adopting the architecture of Northeastern's winning AI hackathon entry.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative, real-time prompt engineering environment where multiple users or specialized agents co-create and optimize complex instruction sets together.
ideas.title: HivePrompt Co-Creation Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the collaborative 'hive coding' paradigm that won the Tech:Europe London Hackathon, making for an engaging, highly visual live demonstration.
